partners.mechanism_chain: ARL6 (HGNC:24075) —DISRUPTS→ Cilium Assembly and Function (GO:0001519); Cilium Assembly and Function (GO:0001519) —LEADS_TO→ Bardet-Biedl syndrome phenotype (HP:0001171); SMO (HGNC:10670) —DISRUPTS→ Hedgehog signaling pathway (GO:0007254); Hedgehog signaling pathway (GO:0007254) —LEADS_TO→ Curry-Jones syndrome phenotype (HP:0031721); Cilium Assembly and Function (GO:0001519) —DISRUPTS→ Hedgehog signaling pathway (GO:0007254).
